kind: owner-authorized UCF-Crime video media access verification; not a research result
owner_approval_statement: Owner authorizes use of the official UCF-Crime video dataset for internal non-commercial SHAR research and academic publication; raw video media, clips, and derived crops may not be redistributed; upstream footage rights remain qualified.
package_match_basis: The corpus holds 1,900 distinct videos in the official CRCV UCF-Crime taxonomy: 950 normal (800 Training_Normal_Videos_Anomaly + 150 Testing_Normal_Videos_Anomaly) and 950 anomaly across the 13 classes. Counted directly on 2026-08-28.
1,950 files resolve to those 1,900 distinct videos; the 50-file surplus is the z_Normal_Videos_event duplicate set described in package_metrics.video_count_note.
Direct video extraction under D-34 defines exact frame-index-to-timestamp mappings.
Measured inventory in results/p0a/inventory-ed66e4a2034c0585 verified 1,950 source-video files with zero content errors.

package_metrics.framerate_note: NOT uniform. Measured 2026-08-25 across all 1,950 MP4s (cv2.VideoCapture CAP_PROP_FPS, no decode) and registered in docs/EVIDENCE_REGISTER.md. D-34's phrase 'all 320x240 at 30 fps' is correct on geometry and imprecise on fps; see K-04. A frame index converts to a timestamp per video only, as source_frame_index / that video's own reported fps -- never treat stride 5 as a global 6 fps.
package_metrics.resolution_note: Uniform. 320x240 for 1,950 of 1,950, zero unopenable files.
package_metrics.video_count_note: 1,950 FILES hold 1,900 DISTINCT videos. All 50 files in Videos/z_Normal_Videos_event/ are byte-identical duplicates of files in Videos/Testing_Normal_Videos_Anomaly/ and ship that way in the official download. Measured 2026-08-25 and registered verified in docs/EVIDENCE_REGISTER.md; see K-11 -- a video stem is not a unique key, so every corpus lookup keys on (source_directory, stem). The 50 duplicate pairs were hardlinked on 2026-08-28 to reclaim 1.02 GB; both paths still resolve and the file count is unchanged.
